Assembly Stdio Features

A comprehensive assembly language IDE for 8088 and IJVM architectures

Getting Started
Assembly Stdio is designed to provide a complete development environment for assembly programming. Navigate through the features below to discover all the powerful tools at your disposal.

File Operations

  • Multi-format Support - Work with .ijvm and .a8088 files
  • Working Directory - Set and manage your project workspace
  • File Management
    • Open existing assembly files
    • Create new files with templates
    • Save as... with automatic extension handling
  • Smart File Detection - Automatic syntax highlighting based on file type

Code Editor

  • Syntax Highlighting - Color-coded assembly instructions
  • Tabbed Interface - Work with multiple files simultaneously
  • Modern Font Support - Scalable fonts that adapt to screen size
  • Auto-indentation - Smart code formatting

Memory Visualization

  • Real-time Updates - Watch memory changes during execution
  • Architecture-specific Display
    • IJVM: Constants, Variables, Stack
    • 8088: SECT DATA, SECT BSS, Stack, Registers
  • Interactive Cells - Double-click any cell to copy its content
  • Dynamic Resizing - Adjust memory panel width
  • Context Switching - Automatic reset when changing file types

Execution Controls

  • Step-by-step Execution - Execute one instruction at a time
  • Bulk Execution - Run 10 instructions at once
  • Play/Pause Control - Continuous execution with pause capability
  • Configurable Timing - Adjust delay between instructions
  • Execution Reset - Start over with a clean state

Input/Output System

  • Interactive Input - Provide input during program execution
  • Real-time Output - View program output immediately
  • Clear Formatting - Easy-to-read I/O display
  • Scrollable Output - Handle large amounts of output data

User Interface

  • Dark Theme - Eye-friendly dark color scheme
  • Scalable Fonts - Automatically adjust to screen resolution
  • Responsive Design - Adapts to different window sizes
  • Professional Styling - Modern, clean interface design

Help & Documentation

  • Built-in Instruction Reference
    • Complete 8088 instruction set documentation
    • Comprehensive IJVM instruction guide
  • Interactive Help - HTML-based documentation viewer
  • Feature Overview - This comprehensive features page
  • Context-sensitive Help - Relevant help based on current context

Settings & Customization

  • Font Configuration - Choose fonts and sizes
  • Display Options - Customize visual appearance
  • Editor Preferences - Configure editing behavior
  • Theme Settings - Adjust color schemes
  • Auto-save Options - Configure automatic file saving

Advanced Features

  • Title Bar Integration
    • Display current working directory
    • Double-click to maximize the window
    • Ctrl+click to open directory in file browser
  • Memory Highlighting - Visual feedback for memory changes
  • File Type Detection - Automatic mode switching
  • Cross-platform Support - Works on multiple operating systems
Pro Tips
  • Use Ctrl+Click on the title bar to quickly access your working directory
  • Double-click memory cells to copy their values for debugging
  • Drag the splitter between editor and memory to optimize your workspace
